KKA0097-ABSBBWB.lead: A lidded meal box that keeps soup or curry apart from the dry dishes.

That round piece rests in a shaped recess, keeping gravy away from the rice, sides and salad in the other sections.

Measuring 30 × 24 × 6 cm under a black wood-grain lid, it fits Japanese and pan-Asian bento sets, mini thali plates and corporate lunch orders, whether served at the table or sent out from a cloud kitchen.

Filled the way the photos show, with rice in a large section, fruit and vegetables in the medium ones, a salad in the round well, nuts along the side strip and dips in the small cups, it carries a balanced single meal for staff canteens, office lunches and subscription kitchens.

KKA0099-GBBWL.meta: Green bento box, 32 × 20 × 4 cm, with a clip-down clear lid over large, medium, square, round and side sections. Kitchenary Kart supplies it for tiffin service.

The photos show it on a counter loaded with cut fruit and cocktail picks, and it works just as well on a chaat or sandwich line: onion, tomato, chilli, sev and coriander each get a tray, and the cover drops over them between orders.
b: Layout: Six trays in the middle plus an open caddy at either end, eight sections in all.

KKA0103-PMB8C.meta: Heavy plastic condiment caddy, 59 × 19 × 17 cm, with six lidded inserts plus two end holders for bar and chaat counters. Available at Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0100-SSBBE.meta: Eco SS thali and bento box, 28.5 × 22 × 4.5 cm, with 5 compartments under one flat cover for canteen, hostel and mess meals. From Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0108-SSMB6C.meta: SS masala box with lid holding six removable steel inserts, about 33.5 × 28.5 cm, for everyday curry-line spices. Available from Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0102-SSLB5C.meta: SS Lunch Box 5C: a five-section stainless plate with a sand-coloured cover, for school meals, staff lunches and prep work. Order it at Kitchenary Kart.

KKA0230-SSMH.meta: Full stainless steel ice and meat hammer, 27 cm, with a toothed cylindrical head and hanging ring for kebab, cutlet and bar prep. At Kitchenary Kart.
